title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://pastebin.com/raw/QGrjKCsR (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The URL https://pastebin.com/raw/QGrjKCsR was observed in the wild as part of attacker activity on 2026-10-25. It is associated with the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it was used for tool download, callback, or exploitation purposes. The activity was detected by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors and originated from attacker infrastructure in Great Britain. There are no known exploits actively using this URL, and no specific affected software versions have been identified.
